title: "Wheeled Mobility Device (WMD) Analysis Script"
author: "Jamie Danemayer"
date: "November 2022"
output:
  html_document:
  self_contained: no
---

Note: 

This script analyses rATA data from countries using national samples, available in the GHO, and with identically cleande data. These include: 
Azerbaijan (AZE), Bhutan (BTN), Burkina Faso (BFA), Djibouti (DJI), Dominican Republic (DOM), Georgia (GEO), Indonesia (IDN), Iran (IRN), Iraq (IRQ), Italy (ITA), Jordan (JOR), 
Kenya (KEN), Libera (LBR), Maldives (MDV), Mongolia (MNG), Myanmar (MMR), Nepal (NPL), Poland (POL), Rwanda (RWA), Senegal (SEN), Togo (TGO), Ukraine (UKR). 

Abbreviations: 

-MFD: Mobility Functional Difficulty
-none: No difficulty
-some: Some difficulty
-cannot.do: Cannot do at all
-any.mfd: Any level of mobility functional difficulty, AKA any 'need' for mobility APs
-any.use: Use of any mobility AP (wc.manual, wc.manual.postural, wc.manual.push, wc.electric, tricycle)
-nb.is.ns:* non-binary, intersex, other/not specified 

List of tables:

-1 Mobilitiy Functional Difficulty by key indices
-2 Wheeled Mobility Device use by key indices
-3 Use, Need, and Unmet need for at least one wheeled mobility device by key indices
-4 Most commonly used wheeled mobility devices
-5 Wheeled mobility device use information 
-6 Most common barriers to accessing wheeled mobility devices

# Part 0: Set up the dataset 

```{r setup, echo = FALSE}
# List what's in the folder 
country_dir <- "C:/Users/Jamie Danemayer/Documents/R/rATA/rata_data/"
country_files <- list.files(path = "C:/Users/Jamie Danemayer/Documents/R/rATA/rata_data/", pattern = "^\\D\\D\\D_clean_w_children.xlsx")
## Utilise country abbrevs
countries <- gsub('(...)_clean_w_children.xlsx', '\\1', country_files) 
## regular expression here is a find and replace, replacing everything in the first ''s with what's in the second ''s; //1 indicates replaces the whole match with what's in group 1 (...)

# Define cols to keep 
keep.cols <- c('AGE', 'SEX', 'MOBILITY', 'HEARING', 'COMM', 'REMEMB', 'SELFCARE', # Demographics, functional domains
                'PROD1', 'PROD2', 'PROD3', # 3 most important products
                'DISTKM1', 'DISTKM2', 'DISTKM3', # Dist. travelled for each product
                'SATPR1', 'SATPR2', 'SATPR3', # Satisfaction with each product
                'SVCPR1', 'SVCPR2', 'SVCPR3', # Satisfaction with assessment/training for each product
                'SATFU1', 'SATFU2', 'SATFU3', # Satisfaction with follow-up/repair for each product
                'SUITPR1', 'SUITPR2', 'SUITPR3', # Suitability to home surroundings for each product
                'UTILPR1', 'UTILPR2', 'UTILPR3', # Extend can do what you want w/each product
                'ENVBAR1', 'ENVBAR2', 'ENVBAR3', # Usefulness in different environments of each product
                'SOURCE1_1', 'SOURCE1_2', 'SOURCE1_3', 'SOURCE1_4', 'SOURCE1_5', 'SOURCE1_87', 'SOURCE1_88', # Source of product 1
                'SOURCE2_1', 'SOURCE2_2', 'SOURCE2_3', 'SOURCE2_4', 'SOURCE2_5', 'SOURCE2_87', 'SOURCE2_88', # Source of product 2
                'SOURCE3_1', 'SOURCE3_2', 'SOURCE3_3', 'SOURCE3_4', 'SOURCE3_5', 'SOURCE3_87', 'SOURCE3_88', # Source of product 3
                'PAYER1_1', 'PAYER1_2', 'PAYER1_3', 'PAYER1_4', 'PAYER1_5', 'PAYER1_6', 'PAYER1_87', 'PAYER1_88', # Payer for product 1
                'PAYER2_1', 'PAYER2_2', 'PAYER2_3', 'PAYER2_4', 'PAYER2_5', 'PAYER2_6', 'PAYER2_87', 'PAYER2_88', # Payer for product 2
                'PAYER3_1', 'PAYER3_2', 'PAYER3_3', 'PAYER3_4', 'PAYER3_5', 'PAYER3_6', 'PAYER3_87', 'PAYER3_88', # Payer for product 3
                'MOBILITYQ_104', 'MOBILITYQ_105', 'MOBILITYQ_106', 'MOBILITYQ_107', 'MOBILITYQ_120', # Use of WMDs
                'MOBILITYU_104', 'MOBILITYU_105', 'MOBILITYU_106', 'MOBILITYU_107', 'MOBILITYU_120', # Unmet need for WMDs
                'BARRIER_1', 'BARRIER_2', 'BARRIER_3', 'BARRIER_4', 'BARRIER_5', 'BARRIER_6', 'BARRIER_7', 'BARRIER_87', 'BARRIER_88' # Barriers to all APs
              )
                # 'DSATPR_1', 'DSATPR_2', 'DSATPR_3', 'DSATPR_4', 'DSATPR_5', 'DSATPR_6', 'DSATPR_87',     
                # 'DSATSVCPR_1', 'DSATSVCPR_2', 'DSATSVCPR_3', 'DSATSVCPR_4', 'DSATSVCPR_5', 'DSATSVCPR_6', 'DSATSVCPR_7', 'DSATSVCPR_87',
                # 'DUTILPR_1', 'DUTILPR_2', 'DUTILPR_3', 'DUTILPR_4', 'DUTILPR_5', 'DUTILPR_6', 'DUTILPR_7', 'DUTILPR_8', 'DUTILPR_9', 'DUTILPR_10', 'DUTILPR_11', 'DUTILPR_87')     

# Read in World Bank data
classes <- read_xlsx(path = "C:/Users/Jamie Danemayer/Documents/R/rATA/CLASS.xlsx")

# Define age groups
ag.10.starts <- c(0, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70)
ag.10.ends <- c(9, 19, 29, 39, 49, 59, 69, 120)

ag.3.starts <- c(2, 18, 65)
ag.3.ends <- c(17, 64, 120)

# Read in files
rm(world_table)
for (i in 1:length(country_files)) {
  # Read in & prep each country
  country_table <- read_xlsx(file.path(country_dir, country_files[i]))
    
  # Keep only relevant cols
  country_table <- country_table[, keep.cols] # defines we want all the rows, and the keep.cols only

  # Add country abbreviation
  country_table['country.code'] <- countries[i]

  # Add income abbreviation
  country_table['income'] <- classes[which(classes$Code == countries[i]), 'Income group']

  # Add 10 yr age group categories
  for (j in 1:length(ag.10.starts)) {
    start <- ag.10.starts[j]
    end <- ag.10.ends[j]
    country_table[which(country_table$AGE >= start & country_table$AGE <= end), "AGE.10"] <- paste0(start, '-', end)
  }

  # Add 3 main age group categories
  for (j in 1:length(ag.3.starts)) {
    start <- ag.3.starts[j]
    end <- ag.3.ends[j]
    country_table[which(country_table$AGE >= start & country_table$AGE <= end), "AGE.3"] <- paste0(start, '-', end)
  }

  # Add 'any mfd' column
  country_table[which(country_table$MOBILITY %in% c(1, 2, 3)), "ANY.MFD"] <- 1
  country_table[which(country_table$MOBILITY %in% c(0, 88, NA)), "ANY.MFD"] <- 0
  # %in% means 'or'

  # Add 'any MFD use' column
  country_table[which(rowSums(country_table[, c("MOBILITYQ_104", "MOBILITYQ_105", "MOBILITYQ_106", "MOBILITYQ_107", "MOBILITYQ_120")]) > 0), "ANY.USE"] <- 1
  country_table[which(rowSums(country_table[, c("MOBILITYQ_104", "MOBILITYQ_105", "MOBILITYQ_106", "MOBILITYQ_107", "MOBILITYQ_120")]) == 0), "ANY.USE"] <- 0
  ## Any country table row WHICH (this is true), in the new col, is 1
  
  # Add 'any unmet' column for WMDs
  country_table[which(rowSums(country_table[, c("MOBILITYU_104", "MOBILITYU_105", "MOBILITYU_106", "MOBILITYU_107", "MOBILITYU_120")]) > 0), "ANY.UNMET"] <- 1
  country_table[which(rowSums(country_table[, c("MOBILITYU_104", "MOBILITYU_105", "MOBILITYU_106", "MOBILITYU_107", "MOBILITYU_120")]) == 0), "ANY.UNMET"] <- 0

  # Add NEED1 column
  country_table[which(country_table$MOBILITY == 1), "NEED1"] <- 1
  country_table[which(country_table$MOBILITY %in% c(0, 2, 3, 88)), "NEED1"] <- 0

  # Add NEED2 column
  country_table[which(country_table$MOBILITY %in% c(2, 3)), "NEED2"] <- 1
  country_table[which(country_table$MOBILITY %in% c(0, 1, 88)), "NEED2"] <- 0

  # Add total need column
  country_table[which(country_table$ANY.USE == 1|country_table$ANY.UNMET == 1), "TOTAL.NEED"] <- 1
  country_table[which(country_table$ANY.USE == 0 & country_table$ANY.UNMET == 0), "TOTAL.NEED"] <- 0

  # Add coverage column
  country_table[which(country_table$ANY.USE == 1 & country_table$TOTAL.NEED == 1), "COVERAGE"] <- 1
  country_table[which(country_table$ANY.USE == 0 | country_table$TOTAL.NEED == 0), "COVERAGE"] <- 0

  # Add use WITHOUT unmet need column (these are for WMDs in general, not matched device-to-device)
  country_table[which(country_table$ANY.USE == 1 & country_table$ANY.UNMET == 0), "USE.NO.UNMET"] <- 1
  country_table[which(country_table$ANY.USE == 0 | country_table$ANY.UNMET == 1), "USE.NO.UNMET"] <- 0
  
  # Add use with unmet need (under-met) column
  country_table[which(country_table$ANY.USE == 1 & country_table$ANY.UNMET == 1), "USE.AND.UNMET"] <- 1
  country_table[which(country_table$ANY.USE == 0 | country_table$ANY.UNMET == 0), "USE.AND.UNMET"] <- 0

  # Add NO use with unmet need (actual unmet need) column
  country_table[which(country_table$ANY.USE == 0 & country_table$ANY.UNMET == 1), "NO.USE.UNMET"] <- 1
  country_table[which(country_table$ANY.USE == 1 | country_table$ANY.UNMET == 0), "NO.USE.UNMET"] <- 0


  # Add to big table
  if (!exists('world_table')) {
    world_table <- country_table
  } else {
    world_table <- rbind(world_table, country_table)
  }
}
View(world_table)

# Define key indices rownames series
## 10 Year age groups rownames
ten.rn <- c("0-9", "10-19", "20-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70+")

## 3 Main age groups rownames
three.rn <- c("2-17", "18-64", "65+")

## Sex rownames
sex.rn <- c("male", "female")

## Location rownames
location.rn <- c("urban", "rural")

## Country income rownames
income.rn <- c("low", "lower-middle", "upper-middle", "high")

## Mobility functional difficulty (MFD) levels rownames
mfd.rn <- c("none", "some", "a lot", "cannot do", "missing")

## Wheeled mobility device (WMD) types rownames
wmd.rn <- c("manual", "manual postural", "manual push", "electric", "tricycle")

## WMD source rownames
source.rn <- c("public", "NGO", "private", "friends/family", "self-made", "other", "don't know")

## Funding rownames
funding.rn <- c("government", "NGO/charity", "employer/school", "insurance", "out-of-pocket", "friends/family", "other", "don't know")

## Distance traveled rownames
distance.rn <- c("<5", "6-25", "26-50", "51-100", ">100", "don't know")

## Product satisfaction rownames
satisfaction.rn <- c("very dissatisfied", "dissatisfied", "neither satisfied nor dissatisfied", "quite satisfied", "very satisfied", "refused/don't know")

## assessment/training and repair/follow-up satisfaction rownames
satisfaction6.rn <- c("very dissatisfied", "dissatisfied", "neither satisfied nor dissatisfied", "quite satisfied", "very satisfied", "na", "refused/don't know")

## Suitable for home/ helps you do what you want rownames useful in different environments rownames
suitable.rn <- c("not at all", "not much", "moderately", "mostly", "completely", "refused/don't know")

## useful in different environments rownames
suitable6.rn <- c("not at all", "not much", "moderately", "mostly", "completely", "na", "refused/don't know")

## Barriers rownames
barriers.rn <- c("not available", "not suitable", "lack of transport/too far", "lack of time", 
                 "lack of support", "cannot afford", "stigma/syness", "other", "do not know about AP")


wt <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wt, sheetName = "World Table")
writeDataTable(wt, sheet = "World Table", x = as.data.frame(world_table), colNames = T, rowNames = T, tableStyle = 'TableStyleLight11')
saveWorkbook(wt, 'world_table.xlsx', overwrite = T)


```

# Part 1: MFD and Key Indices

```{r mfd and indices, echo = FALSE}

# Table 1
# Create the table in parts
t1.0 <- (table(world_table$AGE.10, world_table$MOBILITY))
rownames(t1.0) <- ten.rn

t1.1 <- (table(world_table$SEX, world_table$MOBILITY))
rownames(t1.1) <- sex.rn

t1.3 <- (table(world_table$income, world_table$MOBILITY))
rownames(t1.3) <- income.rn

# Combine to one table
t1 <- rbind(t1.0, t1.1, t1.3)

# Add an overall row
t1.overall <- colSums(t1[9:10, ])
t1 <- rbind(t1.overall, t1)
row.names(t1)[row.names(t1) == '1'] <- 'overall'

# Make a dataframe 
t1 <- as.data.frame(t1)

# Calculate proportions
t1.rs <- rowSums(t1)

t1.prop <- data.frame(
  none = t1$'0',
  none.prop = round((t1$'0'/t1.rs)*100, 1),
  some = t1$'1',
  some.prop = round((t1$'1'/t1.rs)*100, 1),
  a.lot = t1$'2',
  a.lot.prop = round((t1$'2'/t1.rs)*100, 1),
  cannot.do = t1$'3',
  cannot.do.prop = round((t1$'3'/t1.rs)*100, 1),
  missing = t1$'88',
  missing.prop = round((t1$'88'/t1.rs)*100, 1)
)

# Add column for any MFD
t1.prop['any.mfd'] <- rowSums(t1[, c('1', '2', '3')])
t1.prop['any.mfd.prop'] <- rowSums(t1.prop[, c('some.prop', 'a.lot.prop', 'cannot.do.prop')])

# Add a title
# kable(t1.prop, caption = "Mobility Functional Difficulty (MFD) by Key Indices")

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, sheetName = "Table 1")
writeDataTable(wb, sheet = "Table 1", x = as.data.frame(t1.prop), colNames = T, rowNames = T, tableStyle = 'TableStyleLight11')
saveWorkbook(wb, 'wmd.rata.tables.xlsx', overwrite = T)

```

## COVERAGE x income

## COVERAGE x MOBILITY
  t3.4.4 <- table(world_table$MOBILITY, world_table$COVERAGE)

             sum(world_table$ANY.MFD == '1' & world_table$MOBILITYQ_120 == '1')
             )

none.prop <- round((t1$'0'/t1.rs)*100, 3)

                  sum(world_table$ANY.MFD == '1' & world_table$BARRIER_3 == '1'),
                  sum(world_table$ANY.MFD == '1' & world_table$BARRIER_4 == '1'),

                  )

## Create a list for proportions
